newsitem.title: USA: Circon board reviewing revised bid.
newsitem.headline: Circon board reviewing revised bid.

text.p: Circon Corp said Monday it is asking its shareholders to await a board recommendation on the revised bid from U.S. Surgical Corp.
Earlier in the day U.S. Surgical announced that it was reducing its cash tender offer to purchase Circon to $14.50 a share.
U.S. Surgical has been trying to acquire Circon since August, 1996, when it offered $18 a share.

U.S. Surgical also said it was considering a proxy contest to nominate two independent directors to Circon's board to strengthen its effort to take over the supplier of urological and gynecological surgery products.
In a statement, Circon said that its board will review U.S. Surgical's revised bid.
"Shareholders need not take any action at this time," the statement said, adding that shareholders should await board recommendation.
